* This class defines the behavior of fling if the developer wishes to handle it. *

* Subclasses of {@link OnFlingListener} can be used to implement custom fling behavior. * * @see #setOnFlingListener(OnFlingListener)

methods.name: public abstract boolean onFling(int velocityX, int velocityY)
methods.comment:
* Override this to handle a fling given the velocities in both x and y directions.
         * Note that this method will only be called if the associated {@link LayoutManager}
         * supports scrolling and the fling is not handled by nested scrolls first.
         *
         * @param velocityX the fling velocity on the X axis
         * @param velocityY the fling velocity on the Y axis
         * @return true if the fling was handled, false otherwise.

methodNames: public abstract boolean onFling(int velocityX, int velocityY)
